[[File:Green dragon leather detail.png|120px|left]]
'''Green dragon leather''' is used in the [[Crafting]] skill to make [[green dragonhide armour]]. It can be created by giving a [[green dragonhide]] to a [[tanner]]. Tanners can be found in [[Al Kharid]], the [[Ranging Guild]], [[Forthos Dungeon]], [[Kebos Lowlands]], [[Auburnvale]], [[Canifis]], and the [[Crafting Guild]]. Alternatively, green dragon leather can be made using the [[Tan Leather spell]]. Crafting any piece of green dragonhide armour will grant the player 62 experience per hide.
